title: The Walk Timed to the Baker's Window
youtube_title: The Walk Timed to the Baker's Window | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Noticing who helped, and helping back, keeps a home kind.
summary: At a bedroom with the hall light still on, Golda notices that Grandma Nia has already taken care of a walk timed so you would see the baker's window lit. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Golda does one useful thing Grandma Nia did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
